summary: Taipei offers real money in 2026 (plan amended 2026-06-01, press release 2026-11-20). New electric 重型 10,000 / 輕型 6,000; scrapping a 10+ year-old gasoline scooter 19,000 / 10,000; scrapping a pre-2004 two-stroke 22,000 / 13,000. Every 2026 buyer also gets 8,000 battery top-up; households with a child 12 or under get 8,000 more; low-income households 10,000 more. Central MOEA/MOENV money (about 7,000 to 11,300) stacks. City best cases: 33,000 (new) and 49,300 (two-stroke replacement), both needing a child under 12; a no-child four-stroke scrapper gets about 38,300 and a new buyer about 25,000 (our arithmetic). Requirements: Taipei household registration for a full year; old scooter Taipei-registered since before 2026; buy, plate and scrap by 2026-12-31; apply online by 2027-01-10. First come first served: on 2026-11-25 only 194 heavy-class slots remained for old-scooter replacement. No 2027 plan seen, and no parking or charging perks found.
